print.notes: Print shows the first five speeches in two columns (speaker names left, dialogue right) with a large right-pointing brace grouping all five names as simultaneous — per 14.5.2c, Emboss/the transcriber does NOT attempt to duplicate the columns, using the ordinary dialogue format instead, with a single transcriber's note (here the FULL natural-sentence wording, entirely enclosed, unlike Sample 14-5's own partial split) ahead of the group and a 'Solo' note resuming normal dialogue. Each speaker's own name is followed by a print period, not a colon.
print.printFeatures: Two-column (speaker/dialogue) print layout for five simultaneous speeches, grouped by a large brace; ordinary single-column dialogue for the sixth (solo) speech.
